Pesticides do not belong in our food. 

The workers applying these chemicals to our crops show up in full hazmat suits, head to toe. Because direct exposure is dangerous.

And then we eat them.

We feed our kids food treated with pesticides, serve it in school lunches, stock it on grocery store shelves, and call it "safe" because Washington says it falls within legal limits.

There is no acceptable exposure level for poison. Our children deserve safe and healthy food.
